data.narrative:
Crusoe Energy is a Series C-stage AI & Software company founded by Chase Lochmiller and Cully Cavness, currently valued at $10.0B+ post-money following $3.0B+ in cumulative fundraising. The peer universe comprises 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir), with primary stage-matched peers including Figure AI ($39.0B), Skild AI ($14.0B), and Together AI ($8.3B).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis assumes a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yielding an implied value of $17.0B. Peer-median methodology across the 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables produced a median valuation of $14.0B, with a range of $8.3B to $39.0B, reflecting material dispersion in Series C AI company values.

Triangulation of these two methods produces a range of $11.9B to $19.6B, with a median of $15.5B. The current $10.0B valuation sits below the midpoint, suggesting modest upside under both approaches. Key uncertainties include the wide peer valuation range ($8.3B–$39.0B), which reflects heterogeneous investor expectations within the AI sector, and the limited applicability of the single public comparable given stage and business model differences. The median $15.5B implies a 5.5B valuation step from the most recent round.
